Cable Lockout Equipment guide

What Is Cable Lockout Equipment?

Golden ruleTension the cable so that the locked lever or handle cannot move at all; a slack cable invalidates the isolation.

A cable lockout device is a LOTO device made up of a body and a flexible cable attached to it. The cable is passed through valve handles, circuit breaker holes or lid handles, tensioned so that no slack remains, and secured by fitting a safety padlock to the body. In this way one or more energy isolation points are locked out at the same time with a single device.

A cable lockout is the most flexible solution at points with no dedicated lock, irregular shapes or points very close together. For example, you can thread several valves on a manifold onto a single cable and secure them all at once. A cable lockout is a versatile piece of equipment recommended for every LOTO bag as a complement to dedicated locks.

Sofilx LOTO supplies a wide range of cable lockouts for different lengths, environments and team sizes, with adjustable, multi-purpose, economy, retractable, micro and stainless steel cable models.

Product guide

Types of Cable Lockout Equipment

Adjustable cable lockouts

The cable is tensioned to the required length and fixed in the body; it is the most frequently chosen type for valve groups and panel doors.

BD-L01BD-L02BD-L11-1/L11-2

Multi-purpose cable lockouts

Thanks to the many lock holes in the body, several workers can fit their own lock to the same device.

BD-L12BD-L22BD-L31

Stainless steel cable models

Provides long-lasting use against corrosion in humid, chemical-contact and outdoor conditions.

BD-L61BD-L32

Retractable cable lockout

When not in use, the cable is wound inside the body; it is carried easily without tangling.

Micro and universal models

The micro model is used in tight spaces and small holes, while the universal model with PVC-coated steel cable is used at different points.

Buying guide

How to Choose the Right Cable Lockout Equipment?

Check these criteria before ordering. If you are unsure, send a photo and we will choose together.

Ask an expert
  • Cable length: Measure between the two farthest points to be connected and add an allowance for threading and tensioning.
  • Cable material: For electrical applications prefer PVC-coated cable; in damp or chemical environments prefer stainless steel cable.
  • Number of users: For team work, prefer models with a multi-hole body or add an extra lockout hasp.
  • Cable diameter: If the holes and handles the cable will pass through are small, choose thin-cable models such as the micro.
  • Portability: For sets that will be carried often in the field, retractable models with the cable wound into the body keep things tidy.
  • Tagging: Attach a LOTO warning tag to each cable lockout showing who locked it out and why.
Applications

Where Is Cable Lockout Equipment Used?

Valve groups and manifolds

Allows many valves on parallel lines to be locked out together with a single cable.

Electrical panels and switches

Prevents unauthorized operation of cam and rotary switches and circuit breakers.

Machine guards and covers

Reduces mechanical risks by preventing guards and covers from being opened during maintenance.

Shipyards, ports and outdoor sites

With stainless cable models, it offers safe lockout in harsh weather and marine environments.

Frequently asked questions

About Cable Lockout Equipment

If you could not find the answer you are looking for, message us on WhatsApp and we will determine the right model together.

Ask on WhatsApp
When is a cable lockout needed?
If there is no dedicated lockout device for the point to be locked out, or several points must be secured with a single device, a cable lockout is the most practical choice.
Is a cable lockout enough on its own?
No. A cable lockout is the device that provides isolation; each worker must fit their personal safety padlock and warning tag onto it.
How should I determine the cable length?
Measure the total distance between the points to be secured and add some allowance for tensioning; the cable length of each model is stated on the product page.
Can more than one person use the same cable lockout?
Multi-purpose models have several lock holes in the body; on standard models, group lockout is done by adding a lockout hasp to the body.
When should a stainless steel cable be preferred?
For corrosion resistance in humid, chemically exposed, outdoor or marine applications, models with stainless steel cable are recommended.
What is the advantage of a retractable cable lockout?
Because the cable is wound back into the body after use, it does not tangle or take up space and is carried neatly in the LOTO bag.
How much does cable lockout equipment cost?
Prices vary by model, cable material, length and order quantity. For a current quote, you can send us the product code and quantity via our WhatsApp or phone line.
